text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower completed her first step, the 
Make Debut.

A few days later, Rice Shower watched the 
debut race of Mihono Bourbon, who was 
drawing immense attention even among those 
debuting in the same year.

Seeing her bring smiles to so many people 
through her running, Rice Shower resolved 
to compete in the Classic races.

With the goal of catching up to Mihono 
Bourbon... She decided to enter the Spring 
Stakes, a prep race for the Triple Crown 
trail.
